overlaps.locator: Main text Results, printed p.4; Supplementary Fig. S13D caption, printed p.33; Main text Methods, printed p.8; SI Methods, printed p.17
overlaps.definition_divergence: The formal peak definition matches GraphFLA's strict epsilon=0 peak rule, but 135,178 minus the printed S13D denominator implies 516 excluded variants. GraphFLA has 514 peaks and therefore 134,664 nonpeaks. The paper's separate greedy-walk Methods count is also N=134,664 excluding peak variants. No different peak rule or explanation for the two-variant S13D discrepancy is stated in the paper.

overlaps.reason: The implied 516 exclusions are arithmetic from the quoted 135,178 and 134,662 counts, not a paper-stated number; explanation: NOT STATED IN PAPER. The methods' 134,664 greedy-walk denominator agrees with 514 peaks, so no alternate exclusion rule is justified. Do not adjust epsilon or remove two additional variants to force agreement.

The required Methods and Fig. S13 caption text were reused from the existing SI text extraction copied to papers/Papkou2023/sources/Papkou2023_science_adh3860_SM_codex.txt.
blockers.needed_for: Original supplement PDF archival in the dossier; the quoted Methods and caption text are available from the saved text extraction.

verdict_reason: GraphFLA exactly reproduces the Fig. S13E landscape size (n_configs=135,178) and the paper's strict peak count (n_lo=514). The S13D nonpeak denominator is two lower than n_configs minus n_lo and also conflicts with the paper's separate 134,664 greedy-walk Methods count; no alternate exclusion rule is stated. Kimura-walk frequencies and shortest-path multiplicities are definition-incompatible with existing GraphFLA metrics, and plot-only values were not read.
